title.zh: 将莱特省Tanauan的Tanauan工艺与家庭工业学校更名为Leyte州立工艺与贸易学校的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Tanauan School of Craftsmanship and Home Industries in Tanauan, Leyte, to Leyte State School of Arts and Trades
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Tanauan School of Craftsmanship and Home Industries in Tanauan, Leyte, to Leyte State School of Arts and Trades

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1991/ra_7106_1991.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Tanauan School of Craftsmanship and Home Industries in Tanauan, Leyte, is hereby changed to Leyte State School of Arts and Trades.

The College shall offer secondary course in arts and trades, short-term technical or vocational courses, and higher professional instruction and training in arts and trades as may be authorized by the Department of Education, Culture and Sports.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
